ns2:course.label: Aerosol Sampling and Analysis
ns2:course.description: Studies principles of sampling for particles and gases in the field of air pollution; examines instrumental techniques relevant to the design of sampling systems used in process control, ambient air monitoring, and laboratory experiments; methods of sample analysis and their limitations. Same as ATMS 535, ENVS 545, and ME 516. Prerequisite: MATH 385 and CEE 446.
